name.es-ES: Manual de oraciones y otros opúsculos
name.en-US: Manual of Prayers and Other Opuscula
name.pt-BR: Manual de orações e outros opúsculos

description.es-ES: Los opúsculos de devoción de Fray Luis de Granada reunidos en el tomo XI de Cuervo: el Manual de diversas oraciones (1557) y su edición ampliada, el Memorial de lo que debe hacer el cristiano, el Tratado de algunas oraciones, el Vita Christi, el Tratado de la meditación y la Recopilación breve del Libro de la oración.
description.en-US: The devotional opuscula of Fray Luis de Granada gathered in Cuervo's vol. XI: the Manual of various prayers (1557) and its enlarged edition, the Memorial of what a Christian must do, the Treatise on some prayers, the Vita Christi, the Treatise on meditation and the brief Recopilación of the Book of Prayer.
description.pt-BR: Os opúsculos de devoção de Frei Luís de Granada reunidos no tomo XI de Cuervo: o Manual de diversas orações (1557) e sua edição ampliada, o Memorial do que deve fazer o cristão, o Tratado de algumas orações, o Vita Christi, o Tratado da meditação e a Recopilação breve do Livro da oração.

sources.edition: Fr. Luis de Granada, Obras, ed. Justo Cuervo OP, vol. 11 (Madrid: Viuda e hija de Gómez Fuentenebro, 1906-1908). Texts of the 1557 Manual, the later editions and the 1574 Recopilación.
sources.description: Seven pieces, one file each. The prayer and consideration headings printed in capitals are dropped by the cleaning, so the files run on without them; Cuervo's variants are not imported. OCR of the University of Toronto scan, cleaned by script (running heads, page numbers and the editor's prologue removed; lost initial capitals restored from the corpus vocabulary), not proofread.
sources.tierEvidence: Granada's text of the 16th century, reprinted in 1906; Cuervo's edition is in the public domain on archive.org.
